name: Oxford Flowers 102
description: The Oxford Flowers 102 dataset consists of 8,189 images categorized into 102 flower categories native to the United Kingdom. Each category contains between 40 and 258 images, widely utilized as a standard benchmark for fine-grained visual classification.

publisher.name: Visual Geometry Group (VGG), University of Oxford
